verses.original: וַֽיְהִי֙ אַֽחֲרֵי־ כֵ֔ן דָּוִ֛ד אֶת־ וַיַּ֥ךְ פְּלִשְׁתִּ֖ים וַיַּכְנִיעֵ֑ם וַיִּקַּ֥ח דָּוִ֛ד אֶת־ מֶ֥תֶג הָאַמָּ֖ה מִיַּ֥ד פְּלִשְׁתִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ’a·ḥă·rê- ḵên dā·wiḏ ’eṯ- way·yaḵ pə·liš·tîm way·yaḵ·nî·‘êm way·yiq·qaḥ dā·wiḏ ’eṯ- me·ṯeḡ hā·’am·māh mî·yaḏ pə·liš·tîm
verses.literal: Some time later . . . . . . David - defeated the Philistines subdued them and took . . . - vvv Metheg-ammah from the hand of the Philistines

verses.original: וַיַּ֣ךְ אֶת־ מוֹאָ֗ב הַשְׁכֵּ֣ב אוֹתָ֣ם אַ֔רְצָה וַֽיְמַדְּדֵ֤ם בַּחֶ֙בֶל֙ וַיְמַדֵּ֤ד שְׁנֵֽי־ חֲבָלִים֙ לְהָמִ֔ית וּמְלֹ֥א הַחֶ֖בֶל לְהַחֲי֑וֹת מוֹאָב֙ וַתְּהִ֤י לַעֲבָדִ֖ים לְדָוִ֔ד נֹשְׂאֵ֥י מִנְחָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yaḵ ’eṯ- mō·w·’āḇ haš·kêḇ ’ō·w·ṯām ’ar·ṣāh way·mad·də·ḏêm ba·ḥe·ḇel way·mad·dêḏ šə·nê- ḥă·ḇā·lîm lə·hā·mîṯ ū·mə·lō ha·ḥe·ḇel lə·ha·ḥă·yō·wṯ mō·w·’āḇ wat·tə·hî la·‘ă·ḇā·ḏîm lə·ḏā·wiḏ nō·śə·’ê min·ḥāh
verses.literal: [David] also defeated - the Moabites made them lie down - on the ground and measured them off with a cord He measured off with two lengths those to be put to death and with one length those to be spared So the Moabites became subject to David and brought him tribute

verses.original: דָּוִ֔ד אֶת־ וַיַּ֣ךְ הֲדַדְעֶ֥זֶר בֶּן־ רְחֹ֖ב מֶ֣לֶךְ צוֹבָ֑ה בְּלֶכְתּ֕וֹ לְהָשִׁ֥יב יָד֖וֹ בִּֽנְהַר־׃
verses.transliteration: dā·wiḏ ’eṯ- way·yaḵ hă·ḏaḏ·‘e·zer ben- rə·ḥōḇ me·leḵ ṣō·w·ḇāh bə·leḵ·tōw lə·hā·šîḇ yā·ḏōw bin·har-
verses.literal: David - also defeated Hadadezer son of Rehob king of Zobah who had marched out to restore his dominion along the [Euphrates] River

verses.original: דָּוִ֜ד וַיִּלְכֹּ֨ד מִמֶּ֗נּוּ אֶ֤לֶף וּשְׁבַע־ מֵאוֹת֙ פָּרָשִׁ֔ים וְעֶשְׂרִ֥ים אֶ֖לֶף אִ֣ישׁ רַגְלִ֑י דָּוִד֙ אֶת־ וַיְעַקֵּ֤ר כָּל־ הָרֶ֔כֶב מִמֶּ֖נּוּ מֵ֥אָה וַיּוֹתֵ֥ר רָֽכֶב׃
verses.transliteration: dā·wiḏ way·yil·kōḏ mim·men·nū ’e·lep̄ ū·šə·ḇa‘- mê·’ō·wṯ pā·rā·šîm wə·‘eś·rîm ’e·lep̄ ’îš raḡ·lî dā·wiḏ ’eṯ- way·‘aq·qêr kāl- hā·re·ḵeḇ mim·men·nū mê·’āh way·yō·w·ṯêr rā·ḵeḇ
verses.literal: David captured from him a thousand [chariots] seven thousand charioteers and twenty thousand foot soldiers . . . and he - hamstrung all the horses . . . except a hundred he kept for the chariots

verses.original: אֲרַ֣ם דַּמֶּ֔שֶׂק וַתָּבֹא֙ לַעְזֹ֕ר מֶ֣לֶךְ לַהֲדַדְעֶ֖זֶר צוֹבָ֑ה דָּוִד֙ וַיַּ֤ךְ עֶשְׂרִֽים־ וּשְׁנַ֥יִם אֶ֖לֶף בַּֽאֲרָ֔ם אִֽישׁ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·ram dam·me·śeq wat·tā·ḇō la‘·zōr me·leḵ la·hă·ḏaḏ·‘e·zer ṣō·w·ḇāh dā·wiḏ way·yaḵ ‘eś·rîm- ū·šə·na·yim ’e·lep̄ ba·’ă·rām ’îš
verses.literal: When the Arameans of Damascus came to help King Hadadezer of Zobah David struck down twenty-two . . . thousand of [their] men

verses.original: דָּוִ֤ד וַיָּ֨שֶׂם נְצִבִים֙ בַּאֲרַ֣ם דַּמֶּ֔שֶׂק אֲרָם֙ וַתְּהִ֤י לַעֲבָדִ֖ים לְדָוִ֔ד נוֹשְׂאֵ֣י מִנְחָ֑ה יְהוָה֙ אֶת־ דָּוִ֔ד וַיֹּ֤שַׁע בְּכֹ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָלָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: dā·wiḏ way·yā·śem nə·ṣi·ḇîm ba·’ă·ram dam·me·śeq ’ă·rām wat·tə·hî la·‘ă·ḇā·ḏîm lə·ḏā·wiḏ nō·wś·’ê min·ḥāh Yah·weh ’eṯ- dā·wiḏ way·yō·ša‘ bə·ḵōl ’ă·šer hā·lāḵ
verses.literal: Then he placed garrisons in Aram of Damascus and the Arameans became subject to David and brought him tribute So the LORD - made David victorious wherever - he went

verses.original: דָּוִ֗ד אֵ֚ת וַיִּקַּ֣ח הַזָּהָ֔ב שִׁלְטֵ֣י אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָי֔וּ אֶ֖ל עַבְדֵ֣י הֲדַדְעָ֑זֶר וַיְבִיאֵ֖ם יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: dā·wiḏ ’êṯ way·yiq·qaḥ haz·zā·hāḇ šil·ṭê ’ă·šer hā·yū ’el ‘aḇ·ḏê hă·ḏaḏ·‘ā·zer way·ḇî·’êm yə·rū·šā·lim
verses.literal: And David - took the gold shields that belonged to the officers of Hadadezer and brought them to Jerusalem

verses.original: וּמִבֶּ֥טַח וּמִבֵּֽרֹתַ֖י עָרֵ֣י הֲדַדְעָ֑זֶר הַמֶּ֧לֶךְ דָּוִ֛ד לָקַ֞ח מְאֹֽד׃ס הַרְבֵּ֥ה נְחֹ֖שֶׁת
verses.transliteration: ū·mib·be·ṭaḥ ū·mib·bê·rō·ṯay ‘ā·rê hă·ḏaḏ·‘ā·zer ham·me·leḵ dā·wiḏ lā·qaḥ mə·’ōḏ har·bêh nə·ḥō·šeṯ
verses.literal: And from Betah and Berothai cities of Hadadezer King David took a large amount of bronze

verses.original: מֶ֣לֶךְ תֹּ֖עִי חֲמָ֑ת וַיִּשְׁמַ֕ע כִּ֚י דָוִ֔ד אֵ֖ת הִכָּ֣ה כָּל־ חֵ֥יל הֲדַדְעָֽזֶר׃
verses.transliteration: me·leḵ tō·‘î ḥă·māṯ way·yiš·ma‘ kî ḏā·wiḏ ’êṯ hik·kāh kāl- ḥêl hă·ḏaḏ·‘ā·zer
verses.literal: When King Toi of Hamath heard that David - had defeated the entire army of Hadadezer

verses.original: תֹּ֣עִי אֶת־ וַיִּשְׁלַ֣ח בְּנ֣וֹ יֽוֹרָם־ לִשְׁאָל־ אֶל־ הַמֶּֽלֶךְ־ דָּ֠וִד ל֨וֹ לְשָׁל֜וֹם וּֽלְבָרֲכ֗וֹ עַל֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר נִלְחַ֤ם וַיַּכֵּ֔הוּ בַּהֲדַדְעֶ֙זֶר֙ כִּי־ אִ֛ישׁ הֲדַדְעָ֑זֶר הָיָ֣ה מִלְחֲמ֥וֹת תֹּ֖עִי הָי֛וּ וּבְיָד֗וֹ כְּלֵֽי־ כֶ֥סֶף וּכְלֵֽי־ זָהָ֖ב וּכְלֵ֥י נְחֹֽשֶׁת׃
verses.transliteration: tō·‘î ’eṯ- way·yiš·laḥ bə·nōw yō·w·rām- liš·’āl- ’el- ham·me·leḵ- dā·wiḏ lōw lə·šā·lō·wm ū·lə·ḇā·ră·ḵōw ‘al ’ă·šer nil·ḥam way·yak·kê·hū ba·hă·ḏaḏ·‘e·zer kî- ’îš hă·ḏaḏ·‘ā·zer hā·yāh mil·ḥă·mō·wṯ tō·‘î hā·yū ū·ḇə·yā·ḏōw kə·lê- ḵe·sep̄ ū·ḵə·lê- zā·hāḇ ū·ḵə·lê nə·ḥō·šeṯ
verses.literal: he - sent his son Joram to greet - King David - vvv and bless him for - fighting and defeating Hadadezer [who] . . . - had been at war with Toi [Joram] brought with him articles of silver and gold and bronze

verses.original: גַּם־ הַמֶּ֥לֶךְ דָּוִ֖ד הִקְדִּ֛ישׁ אֹתָ֕ם לַֽיהוָ֑ה עִם־ הַכֶּ֤סֶף וְהַזָּהָב֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הִקְדִּ֔ישׁ מִכָּל־ הַגּוֹיִ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר כִּבֵּֽשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: gam- ham·me·leḵ dā·wiḏ hiq·dîš ’ō·ṯām Yah·weh ‘im- hak·ke·sep̄ wə·haz·zā·hāḇ ’ă·šer hiq·dîš mik·kāl hag·gō·w·yim ’ă·šer kib·bêš
verses.literal: and King David dedicated these to the LORD along with the silver and gold - he had dedicated from all the nations - he had subdued

verses.original: מֵאֲרָ֤ם וּמִמּוֹאָב֙ וּמִבְּנֵ֣י עַמּ֔וֹן וּמִפְּלִשְׁתִּ֖ים וּמֵֽעֲמָלֵ֑ק וּמִשְּׁלַ֛ל הֲדַדְעֶ֥זֶר בֶּן־ רְחֹ֖ב מֶ֥לֶךְ צוֹבָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: mê·’ă·rām ū·mim·mō·w·’āḇ ū·mib·bə·nê ‘am·mō·wn ū·mip·pə·liš·tîm ū·mê·‘ă·mā·lêq ū·miš·šə·lal hă·ḏaḏ·‘e·zer ben- rə·ḥōḇ me·leḵ ṣō·w·ḇāh
verses.literal: from Edom and Moab from the Ammonites . . . and Philistines and Amalekites and from the spoil of Hadadezer son of Rehob king of Zobah

verses.original: דָּוִד֙ וַיַּ֤עַשׂ שֵׁ֔ם בְּשֻׁב֕וֹ מֵהַכּוֹת֥וֹ אֶת־ שְׁמוֹנָ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר אָֽלֶף׃ אֲרָ֖ם בְּגֵיא־ מֶ֑לַח
verses.transliteration: dā·wiḏ way·ya·‘aś šêm bə·šu·ḇōw mê·hak·kō·w·ṯōw ’eṯ- šə·mō·w·nāh ‘ā·śār ’ā·lep̄ ’ă·rām bə·ḡê- me·laḥ
verses.literal: And David made a name for himself when he returned from striking down - eighteen . . . thousand Edomites in the Valley of Salt . . .

verses.original: וַיָּ֨שֶׂם נְצִבִ֗ים בְּכָל־ בֶּאֱד֜וֹם כָל־ אֱד֖וֹם אֱדוֹם֙ שָׂ֣ם נְצִבִ֔ים וַיְהִ֥י עֲבָדִ֣ים לְדָוִ֑ד יְהוָה֙ אֶת־ דָּוִ֔ד וַיּ֤וֹשַׁע בְּכֹ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָלָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·śem nə·ṣi·ḇîm bə·ḵāl be·’ĕ·ḏō·wm ḵāl ’ĕ·ḏō·wm ’ĕ·ḏō·wm śām nə·ṣi·ḇîm way·hî ‘ă·ḇā·ḏîm lə·ḏā·wiḏ Yah·weh ’eṯ- dā·wiḏ way·yō·wō·ša‘ bə·ḵōl ’ă·šer hā·lāḵ
verses.literal: He placed garrisons throughout Edom and all - the Edomites . . . . . . were subject to David So the LORD - made David victorious wherever - he went

verses.original: דָּוִ֖ד וַיִּמְלֹ֥ךְ עַל־ כָּל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיְהִ֣י דָוִ֗ד עֹשֶׂ֛ה מִשְׁפָּ֥ט וּצְדָקָ֖ה לְכָל־ עַמּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: dā·wiḏ way·yim·lōḵ ‘al- kāl- yiś·rā·’êl way·hî ḏā·wiḏ ‘ō·śeh miš·pāṭ ū·ṣə·ḏā·qāh lə·ḵāl ‘am·mōw
verses.literal: Thus David reigned over all Israel vvv vvv and administered justice and righteousness for all his people

verses.original: וְיוֹאָ֥ב בֶּן־ צְרוּיָ֖ה עַל־ הַצָּבָ֑א וִיהוֹשָׁפָ֥ט בֶּן־ אֲחִיל֖וּד מַזְכִּֽיר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yō·w·’āḇ ben- ṣə·rū·yāh ‘al- haṣ·ṣā·ḇā wî·hō·wō·šā·p̄āṭ ben- ’ă·ḥî·lūḏ maz·kîr
verses.literal: Joab son of Zeruiah was over the army Jehoshaphat son of Ahilud [was] the recorder

verses.original: וְצָד֧וֹק בֶּן־ אֲחִיט֛וּב וַאֲחִימֶ֥לֶךְ בֶּן־ אֶבְיָתָ֖ר כֹּהֲנִ֑ים וּשְׂרָיָ֖ה סוֹפֵֽר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ṣā·ḏō·wq ben- ’ă·ḥî·ṭūḇ wa·’ă·ḥî·me·leḵ ben- ’eḇ·yā·ṯār kō·hă·nîm ū·śə·rā·yāh sō·w·p̄êr
verses.literal: Zadok son of Ahitub and Ahimelech son of Abiathar were priests Seraiah was the scribe

verses.original: וּבְנָיָ֙הוּ֙ בֶּן־ יְה֣וֹיָדָ֔ע וְהַכְּרֵתִ֖י וְהַפְּלֵתִ֑י דָוִ֖ד וּבְנֵ֥י הָיֽוּ׃פ כֹּהֲנִ֥ים
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·nā·yā·hū ben- yə·hō·w·yā·ḏā‘ wə·hak·kə·rê·ṯî wə·hap·pə·lê·ṯî ḏā·wiḏ ū·ḇə·nê hā·yū kō·hă·nîm
verses.literal: Benaiah son of Jehoiada [was over] the Cherethites and Pelethites and David’s sons were priestly leaders
